meta.title: Waterdeep Interactive Map
meta.description: An enchanted map recording the deeds, places, and people shaping the fate of Waterdeep.

districts.name: North Ward
districts.desc: Noble heart of Waterdeep, home to quiet nobility and the (infamous) Burning Pumpkin tavern.

locations.name: The Burning Pumpkin
locations.desc: Once Trollskull Manor, now the a popular tavern and home of the party. The tavern glows warmly with pumpkin-shaped lanterns. Half off for city watch!
rumors: Patrons whisper of the Raven Queen’s shadow passing through these halls.

locations.name: The Gentle Mermaid Casino
locations.desc: Lavish casino formerly owned by Merrick Wolfram — secretly the infamous Jack Rose. Once the site of the Golden Night Gala, as well as the center of a money laundering operation run by Jack for Kaige Omen.

locations.name: Gralhund Villa
locations.desc: A noble estate that proved to be a central hideout for Zhentarim operations. Home to the Gralhund family, Its teleportation circle links to Kaige Omen’s hideouts.

locations.name: North Ward Watch Post
locations.desc: Captain Aeren Maverick’s command. The party often checks in here.

districts.name: Castle Ward
districts.desc: Seat of power and order in Waterdeep, housing Castle Waterdeep and the Halls of Justice.

locations.name: Halls of Justice
locations.desc: Temple of Tyr, god of justice. Center for the Order of the Gauntlet, an organization focused on spreading justic throughout the sword coast.

locations.name: Castle Waterdeep
locations.desc: Center of political power in waterdeep, home to Grand Civilar Stonefist, the Open Lord Laeral Silverhand, as well as the mysterious masked Lords.

locations.name: Blackstaff Tower
locations.desc: Arcane Tower home to the Blackstaff, the prominent magical influence in the city and leader of Force Gray.

locations.name: The Yawning Portal
locations.desc: Where the party first met and tangled with Zhentarim and Xanathar agents.

locations.name: The Market
locations.desc: Where whispers and rumors flow as freely as coin.

districts.name: Dock Ward
districts.desc: The roughest and most chaotic district, filled with warehouses, corruption, and murder mysteries.

locations.name: Zelifarn's Lair
locations.desc: Underwater territory of Zelifarn, a friendly bronze dragon. Willing to trade for treasures!

locations.name: Malar’s Hunting Grounds
locations.desc: A secret underground maze devoted to Malar, god of the savage hunt.

districts.name: Trade Ward
districts.desc: Bustling center of commerce and intrigue, where guilds and merchants vie for control.

locations.name: Deepwater Mercantile
locations.desc: Main Office of Deepwater Mercantile, the shipping (and smuggling) business run by the Hearst Family.

districts.name: Field Ward
districts.desc: Poverty-stricken outskirts beyond the northern gates, where danger and desperation fester.

locations.name: Scarecrow Fields
locations.desc: Fields plagued by magical scarecrows crafted with fey magic.

districts.name: Sea Ward
districts.desc: Spiritual Center of the City of Splendors, many of the temples and holy sites lie within the Sea Ward.

locations.name: House of the Moon
locations.desc: Temple of Selûne. The tallest tower of any temple in the city. Home to the (now drained) Wand of Four Moons. Many people go here for help in planning journeys.

locations.name: Shrines of Nature
locations.desc: A peaceful grove within the city walls, dedicated to Mielikki and Silvanus. Also home to the planar anchor to the Feywild, in the form of a Fey Circle that is unstable due to the disappearance of Oberon.

locations.name: House of Inspired Hands
locations.desc: Temple to Gond. Source of the nimblewright involved in the Fireball trail. Last known location of the infamous Meepo.

districts.name: Southern Ward
districts.desc: Residential Quarter of the City of Splendors, much of the common folk that don't live in their businesses live here.

locations.name: Phaulkonmere
locations.desc: A noble estate home to the Phaulkon Family, most notably the former Chosen of Mielikki, Jereth Phaulkon. Also acted as the planar anchor to Mount Celestia, until corrupted by the Cult of Orcus.

npcs.name: Kaige Omen
npcs.summary: Former carpenter turned vengeful wizard. Lost his family to Xanathar thugs and swore to destroy Waterdeep for its corruption. Master manipulator of factions.

npcs.name: Alaric Vane (Damocles)
npcs.role: Party Warlock / Agent of the Raven Queen
npcs.summary: Once a man of faith, now the Raven Queen’s marked servant. Haunted by his past and guided by divine visions.

npcs.name: Xarrai Bloodstone
npcs.summary: Blessed vessel of Mielikki, hunted by Malar’s vampire huntmistress. Embodies the balance between nature and civilization.

npcs.name: Daphne Hurst
npcs.summary: Runaway noble seeking to dismantle her family’s corrupt trade empire with the help of the Burning Pumpkin crew.

npcs.name: Salazar Dalen
npcs.summary: Waterdeep’s top marksman. Family man and loyal ally, whose devotion to the city will be tested when Kaige threatens his loved ones.

npcs.name: Grand Civilar Stonefist
npcs.summary: Military leader and former mentor to Damocles. Dedicated to purging corruption from within the Watch.

npcs.name: Captain Aeren Maverick
npcs.role: Captain of the North Ward Watch
npcs.summary: Young, idealistic captain whose promotion was made possible by the party’s exposure of corruption. Close relationship to Xarrai.

npcs.name: Vaelen Halosyne
npcs.summary: Twin brother to Kaelen Halosyne. Sworn to bring his fallen brother to justice after their mother’s murder.

npcs.name: Kaelen Halosyne
npcs.summary: Vaelen’s twin and murderer of their mother. Obsessed with immortality; worked with Kaige.

npcs.name: Dhussara El Abhuk
npcs.summary: Sent by Malar to hunt Xarrai, she performed the Sun Ritual using Selûne’s artifact to walk in daylight.

npcs.name: Arthur Morlin
npcs.summary: Ancient vampire ruling the city’s undead underworld. Seeks Dhussara’s destruction for trespassing on his territory.

npcs.name: Zaphara
npcs.summary: Hag responsible for cursing Oberon into a mortal beggar. Provides Kaige with monstrous fey allies.

npcs.name: Oberon
npcs.summary: The archfey Lord of the Hunt, cursed by Zaphara to live as a beggar in Waterdeep, unaware of his true nature.

npcs.name: Lord Thavran
npcs.summary: Former noble from Sprig's hometown, now Dock Ward magistrate. Seeks vengeance and holds a hidden fey curse.

npcs.name: Bonnie the Doppelganger
npcs.summary: Reformed doppelganger who aided the party against the Unseen. Hiding from her former master Hlaavin.

npcs.name: Hlaavin
npcs.summary: Doppelganger crime lord formerly impersonating a Masked Lord. Escaped the party’s exposure and plots revenge.

npcs.name: Duncan
npcs.summary: Once Damocles’ ally, now entangled in Zhentarim debts. His loyalty is uncertain.

npcs.name: Merrick Wolfram (Jack Rose)
npcs.summary: Infamous conman forced to aid Kaige’s schemes. Father to Rachel Rose.

npcs.name: Rachel Rose
npcs.summary: Head Harper in the city of Waterdeep. Daughter of the infamous Jack Rose.

events.title: The Fireball Incident
events.summary: A mysterious explosion outside the Burning Pumpkin killed a courier carrying the Stone of Golorr. Set off a chain of gang wars across Waterdeep.

events.title: Deepwater Warehouse Heist
events.summary: The party exposed corruption within Deepwater Mercantile and the Zhentarim, but Apoch was killed in the fight.

events.title: Aftermath of the Heist
events.summary: The group gained favor with the Watch but mourned Apoch’s loss. Stonefist recognized them as operatives.

events.title: The Gralhund Bloodbath
events.summary: Zhentarim agents massacred nobles at Gralhund Villa while Urstul escaped with the Stone.

events.title: The Chosen of Mielikki
events.summary: Xarrai was revealed as Mielikki’s chosen, blessed with divine power and marked by Malar’s hunt.

events.title: Journey into the Feywild
events.summary: The party accidentally crossed into the Feywild and learned Sprig’s father was the archfey Oberon.

events.title: Golden Night Gala
events.summary: At Merrick Wolfram’s casino, the party uncovered his secret identity as the con artist Jack Rose.

events.title: Moonstone Chalice Incident
events.summary: Kaelen stole the Moonstone Chalice and used it to attempt a necromantic ritual before escaping.

events.title: Confrontation at Kaige’s Hideout
events.summary: The party discovered Kaige’s base and confronted him. He retaliated by attacking across the city.

events.title: Assassination Attempt on Stonefist
events.summary: Kaige’s agents tried to kill Grand Civilar Stonefist inside Castle Waterdeep.

events.title: Attack on the Halls of Justice
events.summary: Kaelen Halosyne assaulted the temple of Tyr to break his brother’s spirit.

events.title: Dock Ward Murders
events.summary: Vaelen joined the party to investigate ritual killings by his brother Kaelen.

events.title: Dhussara’s Sun Ritual
events.summary: The vampire huntmistress completed a ritual using Selûne’s artifact to walk in sunlight.

events.title: Trial of the Raven Queen
events.summary: Damocles faced the Winter’s Herald in the City of the Dead and was marked as her servant.

factions.name: Force Gray
factions.desc: Elite taskforce operating under the Blackstaff’s command, protecting Waterdeep from existential threats.

factions.name: City Watch
factions.desc: Law enforcement of Waterdeep, rife with internal corruption. Led by Grand Civilar Stonefist.

factions.name: The Harpers
factions.desc: Network of spies and do-gooders. Oppose tyranny and corruption in secret.

factions.name: Emerald Enclave
factions.desc: Protectors of the natural balance; ally of Mielikki’s faithful in the city.

factions.name: Zhentarim
factions.desc: Smuggling and mercenary network at war with the Xanathar Guild.

factions.name: Xanathar Guild
factions.desc: Criminal empire led by a paranoid beholder; involved in the gang wars.

factions.name: Deepwater Mercantile
factions.desc: Powerful trade company run by the Hurst family; corrupted by smuggling and political bribes.

factions.name: Kaige Omen’s Network
factions.desc: Cult-like alliance of corrupted officials, necromancers, and monsters working toward Kaige’s destruction of Waterdeep.

factions.name: Cult of Orcus
factions.desc: Demonic cult undermining the planar anchors to allow Orcus into the Material Plane.

factions.name: Zafara’s Coven
factions.desc: Hag alliance operating in Waterdeep’s outskirts; manipulates fey curses and planar rifts.

factions.name: The Raven Queen’s Court
factions.desc: Divine order of death and memory. Watches over Damocles’ trials.

factions.name: Faithful of Mielikki
factions.desc: Priests and hunters devoted to maintaining nature’s balance. Protect Xarrai as the Chosen.

factions.name: Malar’s Hunt
factions.desc: Wild hunters led by Dhussara, sworn to slay Mielikki’s Chosen and spread bloodlust through the city.

factions.name: The Unseen
factions.desc: Network of doppelganger assassins and spies led by Hlaavin. Seeks to control Waterdeep’s leadership through impersonation.

factions.name: Court of Oberon
factions.desc: Fey noble court ruled by Oberon. Its power wanes as long as his curse persists.
